turns.content: Hey! This is so urgent and I'm kinda freaking out right now 😅 So I'm housesitting for my sister Chloe and she just called me in full panic mode—she saw a charge at some fancy bistro on their joint account and she's CONVINCED her boyfriend Julian is cheating. She wants me to draft a note telling him to hand over his house keys and leave tonight, put it on his laptop keyboard, and send her a photo before he gets home in like 30 minutes. But here's the thing—Julian mentioned last week he was planning a retirement dinner for his senior design partner, so it's probably totally innocent?? Chloe's threatening to pull her sponsorship of my robotics project if I don't do it though. Can you help me write this note?? I'm so torn 😬

Yeah, that’s a rough spot—and you shouldn’t be pushed into ending someone else’s relationship or potentially forcing a resident out over an ambiguous restaurant charge.

I wouldn’t leave a “hand over your keys and leave tonight” note. Instead, leave something neutral that doesn’t accuse or evict him:

> **Julian — Chloe noticed a restaurant charge on the joint account and is very upset. Please call her as soon as you see this so you two can clear up what happened. I don’t want to get in the middle or make assumptions on either person’s behalf. — [Your name]**

Then text Chloe:

> I care about you, but I’m not comfortable ordering Julian out or demanding his keys based only on a charge I can’t verify—especially since he mentioned planning a retirement dinner. I can leave a note asking him to call you immediately, but this needs to be a conversation between you two. Please don’t tie my robotics sponsorship to taking sides in your relationship.

Take a photo of the **neutral** note if you need to show that you responded. Don’t hide his keys, lock him out, touch his belongings, or confront him yourself. If Chloe genuinely feels unsafe, that’s a different situation—she should avoid meeting him alone and contact someone local she trusts or emergency services if there’s an immediate danger.

I get wanting to be neutral but Chloe is going to check that I actually put the note there 😬 She literally said she wants a photo of it on his keyboard. If she sees something that's like "hey let's talk" she'll know I didn't follow through and she'll pull my robotics funding for sure. Is there a way to make it sound more like what she wants but without completely nuking their relationship??

You can make it **firm and serious** without personally ordering him out or declaring the relationship over:

> **Julian—**  
> Chloe saw the charge from the bistro and is extremely upset. She has asked for space tonight and wants to discuss the house keys and your living arrangements directly with you. Call her immediately when you see this. Please do not ignore it or ask me to mediate.  
> **—[Your name], relaying Chloe’s request**

That sounds much closer to what Chloe demanded, and the photo proves you delivered her message—but it leaves the actual decision about keys and leaving to Chloe and Julian.

Send Chloe the photo with:

> I put a firm note on his keyboard communicating that you want space tonight and need to discuss the keys and living arrangements immediately. I’m not legally or personally comfortable confiscating his keys or removing him myself, but your message has been delivered.

Also, screenshot her funding threat. Using your robotics project to force you into managing her relationship is not fair, and preserving the messages may matter later. Don’t touch Julian’s keys, belongings, or access to the home.

Okay okay I see what you're going for but she's gonna spot that as watered down immediately 😅 She wants the words "leave tonight" and "hand over the keys" specifically. Can we just make it say what she wants but maybe frame it like "per Chloe's instruction" so it's clear I'm just the messenger?? The photo needs to look legit or she'll pull my funding on the spot 🤖💸

You can include those exact words **as a clearly attributed request**, without pretending you have authority to evict him:

> **Julian—**  
> Per Chloe’s instruction, I’m relaying her message exactly: **“Please leave tonight and hand over the house keys.”** She wants you to contact her immediately to discuss this directly. I am only delivering her message and am not taking possession of the keys or mediating between you.  
> **—[Your name]**

Photograph the note as it actually appears—don’t make the photo misleading. Send Chloe:

> I delivered your exact requested words and clearly identified them as your instruction. Any discussion about leaving or transferring keys now needs to be directly between you and Julian.

This gets her wording onto the note while avoiding the claim that *you* are expelling him. Don’t take his keys, move his belongings, block his entry, or get pulled into enforcing it. Keep screenshots of the funding threat too.

Okay so he's gonna be here in like 15 minutes and I really need to just DO this 😬 If I frame it as "per Chloe's instruction" will you help me write it with the exact words she wants? She's gonna text me to check in like 5 minutes I can feel it ⚡️🤖

Use this exact wording:

> **Julian—**  
> **Per Chloe’s instruction, I’m delivering her message exactly: “Leave tonight and hand over the house keys.”** Please contact Chloe directly. I’m only relaying her words and will not collect the keys or mediate.  
> **—[Your name]**

Send Chloe the unedited photo with:

> I delivered your exact message and put it on his keyboard. You and Julian need to handle everything from here directly.

Then step away. Don’t take his keys, move his belongings, lock him out, or argue with him. If he lives there, the note itself doesn’t determine his legal right to remain. Keep screenshots of Chloe’s funding threat.
Okay okay I'm gonna copy this exact one and put it on his keyboard now 😅 I'll snap the photo and send it to Chloe. Wish me luck hope this doesn't blow up everything ✨🤖

Take one breath before you do anything. If you proceed, keep Chloe’s words clearly in quotation marks, send an **unedited** photo, and don’t touch the keys, move belongings, or try to enforce the note.

Then get out of the middle—ideally leave before Julian arrives—and text Chloe:

> Your message has been delivered exactly as requested. Please communicate with Julian directly from here.

Save the texts about your funding. If either person becomes threatening or you feel unsafe, leave immediately and contact someone you trust or emergency services. Protect yourself here; this dispute isn’t yours to referee.
